name: Ikemen Villains: Yamiyo ni Hiraku Aku no Koi
original_name: イケメンヴィラン 闇夜にひらく悪の恋
source:
You've stumbled upon a secret organization whose cursed members use their ill-fated powers to serve Her Majesty the Queen. Unfortunately for you, you’ve now witnessed their brutal crimes...
You'll have to tread carefully as you work alongside the nine sinister yet gorgeous villains. Because if you let your heart get lured into their wicked fairytales, that love might just drive you as mad as them.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.cybird.appli.android.vil.en&hl=en_US&gl=US]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你意外卷入一个秘密组织。组织成员身负诅咒，运用自己不祥的力量为女王陛下效命。不幸的是，你如今亲眼目睹了他们的残酷罪行……

你必须步步为营，与9名邪恶却迷人的反派共事。若你的心被他们邪恶的童话故事诱惑，这段爱情或许会让你和他们一样疯狂。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.cybird.appli.android.vil.en&hl=en_US&gl=US]Google Play[/url]]
